setting-BarrelAskEveryTime: Ask every time for instant recipes
settingdesc-Deny: Recipes and results that never get made and never even show up as a choice, /polymorph conflicts lists the lines to use (or just open the conflicts screen and click, way easier)
settingdesc-CraftingGrid: Players get to pick between crafting grid recipes. Off: the grid crafts its first match, like vanilla does
settingdesc-Quern: Players get to pick between quern results. Off: the quern grinds the item own result, plain vanilla
settingdesc-CookingPot: Players get to pick between cooking recipes in a pot. Off: the pot cooks its first match, as vanilla intended
settingdesc-Barrel: Players get to pick between barrel recipes. Off: the barrel uses its first match, vanilla style
settingdesc-QuernSwitchPercent: How far into grinding an item (in percent) you can still change your mind about the result
settingdesc-CookingSwitchPercent: How far into cooking (in percent) you can still change your mind about the recipe
settingdesc-BarrelAskEveryTime: A player filling a barrel gets asked which instant recipe to make every single time. Off: the barrel remembers the choice and only asks the first time
settingdesc-BarrelAutomationWaitSeconds: After asking a player, how many seconds automation (hoppers and friends) waits before going with the remembered choice
settingdesc-BarrelChooseRange: How many blocks away a player can be and still choose for a barrel, no choosing from across the map
result-locked: Result is locked in until this item is ground
result-locked-cooking: Recipe is locked in until this is cooked, no take backs
barrel-choose: More than one recipe fits here, pick what this barrel makes
choose-result: These ingredients can make more than one thing, pick one:
conflicts-hint: Click a result to deny it (click again to let it back in), shift+click keeps only that one and kicks the rest of its conflict out, shift+click again to undo. Save makes it official for everyone
conflicts-keep-only-tip: Shift+click: keep only this one (again to undo)
imm-desc: Pick at which stations players get to choose and tweak the timings, saving applies it for everyone right away. The denylist is easier from the conflicts screen though (/polymorph screen or Ctrl+P)
settings-hint: Hover a setting to see what it does
settings-saved: Polymorph settings saved and applied for everyone, carry on
settings-no-privilege: Only admins (controlserver privilege) can change the Polymorph settings
conflicts-none: No conflicts here, nice and quiet
command-finding: Polymorph is looking for conflicts, big modpack ? grab a snack...
conflicts-loading: Looking for conflicts, big modpack ? grab a snack...
conflicts-reloaded: Denylist reloaded from polymorph.json, {0} lines in use
conflicts-reloaded-invalid: Denylist reloaded from polymorph.json, {0} lines in use. These ones match nothing (typo maybe ?): {1}
conflicts-find-failed: Polymorph could not find the conflicts ({0}), the server log has the details
conflicts-write-failed: Polymorph found the conflicts but could not write polymorph-conflicts.txt ({0}), the screen still works though
conflicts-saved: Denylist saved, {0} lines. The server has spoken
conflicts-player-only: The conflicts screen needs a player to open for, from the console /polymorph conflicts still writes the file
conflicts-screen-no-privilege: Only admins (controlserver privilege) can open the Polymorph conflicts screen
conflicts-no-privilege: Only admins (controlserver privilege) can change the denylist
ground-into-more: When ground: Turns into {0}x {1} and {2} more
